title: Real-time MTConnect/OPC-UA adaptive feed/spindle/thermal feedback loop
brief: L3 is offline planning today. MTConnect/OPC-UA dispatchers exist but no in-cycle feedback loop closes them (chatter, spindle-load override, thermal comp). Architect risk #1. Required for any 'intelligent' marketing claim post-pilot.

phases.title: MTConnect ingest + adaptive override engine + thermal comp

units.title: MTConnect/OPC-UA streaming ingest with backpressure
exit_conditions: streaming ingest from 1 mill + 1 lathe + 1 WEDM at 10Hz
backpressure: drop oldest if consumer lags >500ms
units.description: Reuse existing MTConnect/OPC-UA dispatchers. Add streaming endpoint + buffer.

units.title: AdaptiveControlEngine: chatter detection + feed override <200ms
exit_conditions: chatter onset (FFT spike at known stability lobe) triggers spindle-speed shift within 200ms
1 staged chatter scenario suppressed within 3 RPM steps
tests: synthetic chatter signal + non-chatter noise (false-positive rate <5%)
units.description: Reuse SpindleHarmonicsQualityEngine + chatter probability. Add fast-path override.

units.title: Thermal compensation: spindle dT > 15C engages comp
exit_conditions: dT >15C engages comp from machine thermal-map registry
tests: simulated thermal ramp -> comp engages at correct threshold
units.description: Standard thermal-comp tables per machine. Reuse MachineRegistry thermal-map fields if present, else add.

acceptance: in-cycle MTConnect feed-rate override demonstrated on 1 mill + 1 lathe + 1 WEDM; chatter onset triggers spindle-speed shift within 200ms; thermal-comp engages when spindle dT>15C; no false-positives suppress legitimate cuts.

risks.description: Real-time loop on Windows with NTFS/network jitter blows 200ms budget; mitigation = pin process priority + use IPC over socket not file
OPC-UA security; covered by MS20 OT-IT-SECURITY
